text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Um, sorry, but I can't stay any longer!
I have things to do, so...

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Please, work with us here~!
With all eyes on Scarlet-san, so many of our readers are waiting for an exclusive close-up feature!

In the morning, reporters were aggressively seeking interviews in front of the academy.
I couldn't overlook such persistent pestering.
Just as I moved to intervene...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: HEEEEEEEY!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Hey, you!
Stop bothering our students!

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
N-No, that's not what I meant...!
We're just doing our job here—

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: If you're in trouble, *whoosh*—I arrive!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I am Aston Machan. Call me Machan.
I'm good friends with Scarlet, you see.

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Ah, yes! I've heard so much about your achievements!
Um, from Chan-san as well...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Let us be on our way, then.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry. Ma-chan and Hishi Ama-san will provide a mountain of alternative scoops.
Lots of great footage, much to our delight.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"H-Hold on, Chan-me!
You don't have to push yourself!
I'm sure she's busy too, so...!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha! Don't worry about it!
Leave this to me and get going!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: You're a reporter, aren't you? ...Smash that like, okay?

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text: Ah, uh, yes...!

I'm worried about the reporter, and about Aston Machan...
I decided to wait and see how things play out for a while.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Ta-da! All right, first up is the cafeteria. You're curious about what Umamusume eat, right?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Beyond offering limited-edition seasonal menus,
it's a chic spot that serves as a buffet by day
and transforms into a cafe from 3:00 PM onward.

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text: O-Oho... I see.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
If you ever plan a collaboration cafe,
please let Chan-ma get in on it.
Definitely. As your mascot character.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Pretty shrewd of you.
Well, when dealing with a pushy opponent, being pushy right back should be totally fine!

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Ah, isn't that the one over there
rumored to be a strong Triple Crown contender...!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Hey, cut out the ambush interviews!
Don't you forget that Umamusume come first around here!

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text: Whoa, I-I'm sorry!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
No looking away allowed!
Today's reporter is right over here~!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Now then, allow Machan to show you her dance.
Please feel free to take lots of photos.

Hishi Amazon tries to scold her,
while Aston Machan drags everyone into it.

Steering the reporters with their contrasting styles of assertiveness,
the interview proceeded...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Phew, somehow we made it through!
I'm so glad they went home happy after all that!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Um, Senpai! Chan-Me-chan!
I'm so sorry for dumping that on you!
Thank you for helping me out...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry about it!
We all need a helping hand now and then, right?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Yup yup. They took lots of
pictures of Machan too.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"If you ever need help in the future, just say the word.
Who knows, it might just be
a Chan-Chance."

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Keep Chan-Me Rescue close to your heart.
Please send all inquiries to Chan-Me LANE or our official account.

She had a gentle aura about her,
but come to think of it, she could be quite pushy.
Seeing that side of her...
choice_data_list: When the two of you join forces, you're invincible!
When the two of you combine your strength, you're unstoppable!
It's all in how you look at it, huh

text_block_list.text:
She had a gentle aura about her,
but come to think of it, she could be quite pushy.
Seeing that side of her...
choice_data_list: When the two of you join forces, you're invincible!
When the two of you combine your strength, you're unstoppable!
It's all in how you look at it, huh

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Ho-hoh, what a catchy
phrase. The two of them are invincible.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
What do you think, Hishi Ama-san?
From now on when we team up, how about we introduce ourselves with a fanfare?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Wait, shouldn't you be a little embarrassed by that?!
"Even so, despite their different styles, I could tell both helpers possessed a strong and fiery spirit."

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Hmm? You look like you want to say something.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Trainer,
"Strike while the iron is hot."
When you've got an opening, go all out.

Soft-spoken, yet resolute.
This incident was a reminder of what made
Aston Machan who she was.
